digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and core push integration
propositions: Both bridge workflow CAS loops and reconciler raw-git exemption must be removed and replaced with single strict synchronous core push entrypoint calls
Reconciler and canary workflows must delegate commit-and-push and push-only actions respectively to core while preserving exact bot identity, commit subject, and author metadata
Strict workflow delivery must remain synchronous and red on exhausted failure; core owns retry and CAS recovery; Python library and MCP retain best-effort defaults

Workflow tests must verify absence of inline fetch/merge/retry loops, presence of exactly one complete core push action per workflow, and correct disposition on successful delivery and rejected-push failure
